content.value: In an industrial process the diameter of a ball bearing is an important component 15 part. The buyer sets specification on the diameter to be $3 . 0 \pm 0 . 0 1$ cm. The implication is that in the process the diameter of a ball bearing has a normal distribution with mean $\mu = 3 . 0$ and standard deviation $\sigma = 0 . 0 0 5$ . On average, how many manufactured ball bearings will be scrapped?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2021
